newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia submarine firm wins Thai navy order.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia submarine firm wins Thai navy order.

text.p: The Australian Submarine Corporation (ASC) said on Monday it had won a substantial contract to build three patrol boats for the Royal Thai Navy in a joint venture with the Bangkok-based Silkline International Corporation.

"This is a significant development for ASC as it provides us with an important foothold in Thailand - a defence market with considerable growth potential," ASC managing director Hans Ohff said in a statement.
A company spokesman said the value of the contract, the first stage of an 18 vessel programme, could not be disclosed.
Ohff said the three 30-metre vessels would be built at Silkline's shipyard at Pranburi, 200 km south of Bangkok.
The design, major item procurement, project management, building supervision and logistic support would be provided by ASC from Australia, he said.
Ohff said Silkline was a young and aggressive company "and we are looking forward to forming a strategic long-term alliance with them."
The ASC was currently building six Collins Class submarines for the Royal Australian Navy, with its second, the Farncomb, soon to begin sea trials. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
